description: Late payments made by the Department of Transport and Main Roads is a dataset listed in Queensland Government open data portal (data.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. Report on late payments made by the Department of Transport and Main Roads up to 30 June 2020. The Queensland Government On-time Payment policy was implemented on 1 July 2020 and replaces the Late Payments dataset which ended on 30th June 2020. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are business and industry, finance, government. It offers 26 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2021-06-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-queensland-government-open-data-portal.
